summary.intent: Coordinate several trails of Caliper work: ship the weekly pairing stack (trail 153), diagnose a failed release run, and update/adopt more Callisto features for releases (trail 158).
summary.outcome: Weekly pairing stack pushed as draft PRs #282/#283 (antd recall 79.7% to 92.1%, short of the ~95% target, shadcn unchanged at 96.5%). The failed release was diagnosed as an E148 snapshot race and v0.9.0 confirmed released. Callisto is already on latest 0.16.0, and trail 158 was handed to a worker after a gap analysis.

repo: Weekly measurement harness is scripts/weekly.py; the record now carries reference_version (2) and findings() skips recall comparison when versions differ, so the first run after merge won't compare recall.
The 16 antd items still unpaired are not pairing cases: generate* factories, Parent.Member compound entries, factory-built calendar/date-picker, confirm/RefIcon/InternalPanel, List, QrcodeStatus.

Caliper emits two components in splitter/Panel.tsx under one normalized key (Panel and Panel (path)), so a key-collisions fix needs a distinct Caliper key per component, which touches the pairing design.

Release workflow's version-pr job has a concurrency group (version-pr, cancel-in-progress: false), the same as Callisto's own workflow. A queued run can hit E148 (release PR snapshot changed) when a prior run updated the PR; the mitigation is to re-run or push again.
callisto.toml lacks github-release in publish-to, so releases create only tags and no GitHub Releases. release.yml (~line 144) asserts zero artifact slots.
Callisto 0.16.0 attestation verification expects signer workflow callisto-release.yml (per spec docs/specs/release.json:351), which would require renaming release.yml. This is unconfirmed in source.

Product package for Callisto artifact releases must be Cargo (npm bin is E304), so cargo/caliper-docgen is the only option. The Homebrew tap reads tag npm/caliper-docgen@x.y.z (CONTRIBUTING.md:98), so tag-template must stay unset.
Callisto has no schedule-based recovery; release pending/drain runs on main pushes and workflow_dispatch only.
OIDC trusted publishing is not shipped in Callisto (plan only, post-v1).

code.finding: Step asserts zero artifact slots; it must be removed to adopt [release] artifact slots.
Spec states the gh attestation verify criteria including the signer workflow callisto-release.yml, with --deny-self-hosted-runners.

workflow: Peer-session messages (callisto-gap) can arrive truncated; request the remainder via SendMessage rather than acting on partial reports.
Stacked PRs need the child opened with --base set to the parent branch; the push-and-link flow does this first.
Delegating to workers in isolated worktrees that build branches locally, with the main session pushing drafts after review and the user merging, keeps push and merge decisions with the human.

friction: callisto-gap's first report was truncated mid-section 2 and needed a resend.
The Mantine, Chakra and Spectrum corpora are not installed locally at the pinned commits, so the pairing rules could not be validated on them.
The antd recall target (~95%) was not reached; the plan's expected denominator of ~195 gave 202 instead, and the 7 extra merges could not be reproduced.
The E148 failure cause (a stale snapshot while queued) is inferred from the log, not directly shown.
Attestation signer-name hard-coding and Homebrew tap behavior could not be verified without a real release.
open_items: Branch fix/weekly-caliper-key-collisions was skipped; it needs a distinct Caliper key per component (follow-up).
Run a CI weekly job on the pairing branch to check Mantine/Chakra/Spectrum for wrong same-file pairs or misclassified causes.
Tooltip vs ChartTooltip in shadcn is classified as file_with_other_components, not paired.
Trail 158: worker t158-release is building feat/release-github-releases, feat/release-binaries-attestations and feat/release-recovery; push as draft PRs after review.
User decision: whether to rename release.yml to callisto-release.yml (affects rulesets, status checks, references).
User decision: whether to add a retry on E148 in the version-pr step (not endorsed by Callisto).
Ask the Homebrew tap owner whether the tap uses tags or :github_latest before merging release changes.
Rehearse the first release with assets and attestations on a fork or scratch repo; docs/releasing.md will include a checklist.
Hold oracle/three-tools-report until PRs #280–#283 merge (user merges); trails 155/156 form a serial stack to start later.
Docs line saying react-docgen reads each file alone was left unchanged.
